{{Short description|Swiss chemist (1936–2021)}}
'''Alexander von Zelewsky''' (born 17 July 1936, [[Zürich|Zurich]], [[Switzerland]], died 25 January 2021, [[Fribourg]]) was a full Professor in [[chemistry]] at the [[University of Fribourg]] in [[Fribourg]], Switzerland, from 1969 to 2006.

== Career ==
After obtaining his diploma in 1960 at the [[ETH Zurich|ETHZ]], Alexander von Zelewsky did his [[Doctor of Philosophy|Ph.D]] (1960 - 1964) under the direction of Professors Walter Schneider and [[Gerold Schwarzenbach]] on "EPR-Spektren von Komplexen des zweiwertigen Kupfers mit Pyridin und Pyridinderivaten".<ref>{{Cite thesis|last=von Zelewsky|first=Alexander|title=EPR-Spektren von Komplexen des zweiwertigen Kupfers mit Pyridin und Pyridinderivaten|date=1964|publisher=ETH Zurich|url=https://www.research-collection.ethz.ch/handle/20.500.11850/131445|doi=10.3929/ethz-a-000087599|hdl=20.500.11850/131445 |language=de}}</ref> He then became a Miller fellow<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://miller.berkeley.edu/fellowship/members/all-by-term|title=Miller Institute UC Berkeley, all members|website=miller.berkeley.edu|language=en-GB|access-date=2018-03-06}}</ref> at the [[University of California, Berkeley|University of California]], [[Berkeley, California|Berkeley]], under Professor [[Robert E. Connick]].

In 1967 he went back to Switzerland to become lecturer at ETHZ (1967 - 1969) and later full Professor of [[inorganic chemistry]] at the University of Fribourg (1969 - 2006).<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www-chem.unifr.ch/en/research/emeriti|title=Department of Chemistry » Emeriti|website=www-chem.unifr.ch|access-date=2018-03-06}}</ref> During these years his fields of interests were [[Electron paramagnetic resonance|EPR spectroscopy]] as well as synthesis and characterization of [[Coordination complex|coordination compounds]].

Alexander von Zelewsky was the Dean of the Faculty of Science of the University of Fribourg from 1974 to 1975 and from 2000 to 2002, the president of the [http://scg.ch/index.php?lang=en Swiss Chemical Society] between 1997 and 1999 and the president of the [[Swiss National Science Foundation]] (Science division) from 1984 to 1992.

== Awards ==
* 1964 Silver medal of the ETHZ.
* 1965 - 1967 Miller Fellowship.
* 1997 Honorary Ph.D degree at the [[University of Neuchâtel]], [[Neuchâtel]], Switzerland.
